subject: Clarifying indemnity tiering, IP carveouts, and evidence/demo request
messages:
From: Jenna Sullivan <jenna.sullivan@brightmap.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: legal@brightmap.com
Date: Fri, 07 Dec 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: BrightMap proposed redlines to MSA / order form (indemnity sections)

Hi Kimberly / Marcus,

Thanks again for the early walkthrough this week. Attached are BrightMap's redlines (BrightMap_Redlines_v3.docx) to the MSA and order form focused on IP/third-party claims and customer indemnity. High-level asks from our side: 

- Limit Redwood's indemnity for third-party IP to claims arising from Redwood's gross negligence or willful infringement; carve out model-generated output unless directly attributable to Redwood-provided third-party content.
- Add an explicit OSS exception (we supply attribution and provenance, not indemnity).
- Cap liability tied to indemnity at the greater of $5M or the total fees paid in 12 months; consider a stepped waterfall if we go over committed spend.
- Defense control: BrightMap would like the right to control defense for IP claims but are open to Redwood leading if BrightMap can approve counsel and settlement.

To evaluate the operational impact we need: a short evidence packet (SOC2 excerpt, data retention commitments, evidence-index) and a 20–30 minute demo/call with your security/product engineer to understand model provenance and logging.

Could you confirm Redwood's position on the OSS carveout and defense-control options? Also let us know whether you can commit the requested evidence packet by next Tuesday (12/12).

Best,
Jenna Sullivan
Counsel, BrightMap Systems

--
Attachment: BrightMap_Redlines_v3.docx (docx, 124 KB)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jenna Sullivan <jenna.sullivan@brightmap.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 07 Dec 2028 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BrightMap proposed redlines to MSA / order form (indemnity sections)

Jenna—

Appreciate the clear redlines and the asks. Quick responses to your bullets below, plus next steps.

- OSS carveout: Redwood's standard position is an express open-source carveout (we do not indemnify OSS), and we can add stronger provenance language. We'll propose specific text that maps to the packages in your exhibit if you can provide a short inventory.

- Model-generated output: We treat model output indemnity carefully. We can accept a narrow obligation for third-party claims where Redwood has directly embedded or supplied third-party proprietary content (e.g., a licensed knowledge pack). We are not in a position to indemnify against arbitrary downstream user prompts that produce third-party-like output.

- Cap / waterfall: Commercial team needs to weigh in. Our legal baseline caps consequential exposure in line with the order form; we can propose a three-tier cap (order value, 6x order value up to $5M, and an exec-level exception for material strategic deals).

- Defense control: We typically retain defense control for IP claims with an obligation to consult. We can consider BrightMap having defense control for customer-originated claims if BrightMap funds outside counsel and Redwood can approve counsel selection.

Next steps I propose:
1) Marcus/Aditya please confirm commercial flexibility on cap/waterfall and whether a pricing concession is available tied to acceptance of our defense-control language.
2) I will draft counterlanguage for OSS carveout + model-output carve limits and circulate.
3) Grace — can you own assembling the evidence packet (SOC2 excerpt + evidence-index) and coordinate a 30-min security/product call? Jenna asked for delivery by 12/12; is that feasible?

If we can close these items quickly it's likely we can keep the deal timeline intact.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

--

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jenna Sullivan <jenna.sullivan@brightmap.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 07 Dec 2028 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BrightMap proposed redlines to MSA / order form (indemnity sections)

Kim / team—

From a commercial perspective we have room to be flexible on cap structuring for strategic accounts. Two quick options we can present to BrightMap: 

Option A (standard): Cap tied to 12-month fees, with the floor set at $1M and ceiling at $5M. No explicit multiplier.

Option B (tiered concession): For customers committing to a 12-month Reserved plan >= $600k, we offer a stepped cap: 2x annual fees up to $3M, then company-level cap at $5M. If BrightMap accepts our standard defense-control language (Redwood leads, consults with customer), we'll offer a 10% credit on first-year reserved fees (commercial discount).

We should present both options and ask BrightMap which path they prefer. If they insist on defense-control-forced-to-them we need to escalate to execs before offering any material discount.

Also — happy to join the security/product call to confirm what logging/provenance we capture.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Director, Commercial Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jenna Sullivan <jenna.sullivan@brightmap.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 08 Dec 2028 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BrightMap proposed redlines to MSA / order form (indemnity sections)

Jenna—

Thanks for the redlines. Quick summary of what we'll send as a formal counter by EOD Monday (12/11):

- Draft language: explicit OSS carveout, narrow model-output limited indemnity tied to Redwood-supplied third-party content, and suggested wording for counsel-approval if BrightMap leads defense.
- Commercial proposal: We will put Options A and B (see Aditya's note) on paper so you can pick. Option B includes a first-year credit in exchange for Redwood defense-control.
- Evidence & demo: Grace will assemble the evidence-index and SOC2 excerpt; we can get a 30-min security/product call on the calendar for Tues 12/12 at 10:00 AM PT. If that works, Grace will send a calendar invite and a brief demo recording post-call.

Action items for BrightMap: please share a short OSS package list if you want specific projects excluded from indemnity, and confirm whether you prefer option A or B (commercial) or want us to propose the combined compromise.

I'll circulate the draft counterlanguage Monday morning. Appreciate the collaborative tone — want to keep this moving.

Best regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
